title: pilosella bryhnii
intro: Pilosella bryhnii, commonly known as Bryhn's hawk's beard or a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family, is a rare and endangered species found in Norway. The plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella bryhnii include its potential to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal activities, as well as its ability to modulate the immune system. Bioactive constituents present in Pilosella bryhnii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
